meta.method: Zones are built from 4H, 1D and 1W data. Seven independent methods are checked per zone: swing/equal highs-lows, order blocks, FVGs, EMA20/50/100/200, fib retracement of the dominant swing, breakout-retest shelf, high-volume node. A zone needs 3+ different methods.
